purpose: Teach: みなす/逃れる/しようが/見なさ/傾き/負い/懲り/劣る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、俺を友達とみなすの嬉しいぜ
lines.en: Riku — you know I'm glad you consider me a friend, right?
lines.style: Warm tease, eyes bright. Quick rhythm on the challenge. Slight vulnerability underneath, checking if it lands. Leans in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強から逃れる方法考えてたな、桜
lines.en: You were trying to figure out how to escape studying, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry observation, knowing smile. Slow delivery on the accusation. Not unkind — amused at catching her. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、しようがないって諦め癖あるな
lines.en: You have this habit of just giving up and saying it can't be helped, don't you?
lines.style: Playful jab with a grain of real concern underneath. Quick rhythm. Points the observation like she's holding up a mirror, not attacking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、後輩に軽く見なされてたな、桜
lines.en: The juniors didn't take you seriously back then, did they, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet call-out. Pause before her name. Not harsh — stating something he noticed that she might've missed. Slight grimace, like it cost him to say.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、机の傾き気にしてたな
lines.en: You noticed that the desk was tilted, didn't you?
lines.style: Surprised respect in the tone. Slight rise at the end like he's genuinely impressed she caught that detail. Softer than his previous lines.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、責任を負いたがらないな、桜
lines.en: You don't want to take responsibility for things, do you, Sakura?
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Direct challenge delivered with care. Slower pace. The tone of someone who sees her avoiding something and won't let her off easy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テストで懲りずに同じミスしてたな
lines.en: You made the same mistake on the test without learning from it, didn't you?
lines.style: Exasperated fondness. A little sharper here — the frustration of watching someone you care about repeat a pattern. Quick clip on the key words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、運動で劣る分、勉強で頑張れよ、桜
lines.en: You're not as good at sports, so you'd better put in the effort with studying, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct instruction softened by genuine encouragement. Lean forward slightly. The tone of someone who believes in her and is pushing because of it, not despite it.
